draft.heroMessage: Your North Idaho real estate expert, serving the Silver Valley with integrity and deep local knowledge.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Cindy Carlson Realty, where your dreams for home and land in North Idaho are met with unmatched service and commitment.
draft.tagline: Serving the Silver Valley and Beyond with Dedication & Heart
draft.aboutParagraph: With over 18 years of experience in residential and commercial real estate, Cindy Carlson brings a personal connection and a wealth of local expertise to every client relationship. As the broker and owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, Cindy has dedicated herself to helping clients navigate life’s biggest transitions—whether finding a dream home, securing an investment, or relocating to the beautiful Silver Valley area. As a long-time resident who’s given back to the community and advocated for area growth, Cindy offers not only professional guidance but true neighborly care. Her designations—including ABR, CRS, GRI, and RSPS—underscore her commitment to elevating service with advanced education and best practices.
draft.conciergeLine: Questions about the Silver Valley or North Idaho? Reach out—Cindy is always ready to offer honest answers and sound advice.
draft.contactLine: Call Cindy directly at (208) 512-0078 or email cindy@cindycarlsonrealty.com to start your real estate journey today.
draft.tone: Warm, knowledgeable, and community-centered with a focus on personal connection and local expertise.

THE AREA
North Idaho’s Silver Valley
Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
ABOUT
Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.
